branches.APPLIED: Skip APPLY entirely; read same Item and compare formal original receipt with independent Backend/Supabase. An advanced revision is reported, never reset.
branches.UNKNOWN_NOT_VISIBLE_OR_NOT_FOUND_NOT_NO_: Not automatic retry permission. Wait for independent same-account revision1/unchanged fields/receipt absence AND explicit new Gate allowing one original-bb retry, then fresh Confirm and at most one APPLY.
branches.OTHER_TERMINAL_OR_UNQUALIFIED: STOP on CONFLICT/REJECTED/NO_CHANGE, unavailable recovery, auth failure, timeout, malformed result or mismatched evidence. No POST or reconnection.

execution: One observed result at a time; no runner or batch. No fresh PREVIEW needed solely because Session changed. Any command/revision/field mismatch stops; never alter original bb payload or allocate replacement IDs.
afterApply: UNKNOWN/error/timeout => STOP, retain original bb and query only if validly authorized; no second POST/new ID/automatic retry.
independentAfter: Formal original-bb receipt and exact Item/revision/date readback by normal Backend plus Supabase
Native same exact Item auto date update and cold recovery; never edit local data to match
cleanup: Normal same-client revoke/fresh absence, one same-connection read probe only on Auth cue, durable safe projection before temporary container removal when available, full negative restoration; no extension/restart.
